```csharp
(OutSystems.Model.IESpace eSpace) => {
    
    /*** creating IClientAction 'ScrollTop' ***/
    var scrollTop = eSpace.CreateClientAction("ScrollTop");
    scrollTop.Description = "ScrollTop (synthetic)";
    scrollTop.Public = false; // default value
    
    var startNode = scrollTop.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IStartNode>();
    var showToast = scrollTop.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IExecuteClientActionNode>("ShowToast");
    var showToast2 = eSpace.ClientActions.Named("ShowToast");
    showToast.Action = showToast2;
    startNode.Target = showToast;
    var endNode = scrollTop.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IEndNode>();
    showToast.Target = endNode;
}
```
